offering_description.value: Sells dietary supplements, skin and personal care products, and nutritional products such as Protandim, Omega+ and Axio. Products are sold to independent distributors and their customers through a multi-level direct selling model, with manufacturing outsourced to contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: nutrigenomic dietary supplements; antioxidant supplements; skin care products; energy and focus drinks; weight management products

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers and preferred customers buying wellness products; B2B: independent distributors who buy products and build sales networks

end_markets.value: health and wellness; dietary supplements; personal care and skincare

revenue_model.value: product sales: supplements and skincare sold to distributors and customers through direct selling network

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded wellness products made by contract manufacturers, sold via independent distributors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe, Mexico and Latin America, Canada, Australia

specialization.value: related lines: nutrigenomic supplements, nutritional products and skin care sold through the same direct selling channel

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: multi-level network of independent distributors; online: company e-commerce site and distributor replicated websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: supplement and cosmetic rules from FDA and FTC, plus direct selling and multi-level marketing regulations in each country
